name: Barrett Luxell
source:
[i]"What does it matter? I'm 'defective.'"[/i]

[i]Reluctant Warrior[/i]

A senior Sylphid who also serves as a tutor for the heroine. He's prone to arguing and tends to be in a foul mood, but from the way he helps with her training, he's clearly just as caring.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=barrett]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
